plan.title: Child Development Impact
plan.subtitle: Comparing baseline to endline physical metrics by location and coach

panels.title: Total Children Tracked
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM baseline UNION SELECT "Child ID" FROM endline) t

panels.title: Avg Height Gain (cm)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gain), 1) AS n FROM (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Height cm" - e."Height cm" AS gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") t

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Gain
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gain), 1) AS n FROM (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups" AS gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") t

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Improvement (sec)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gain), 1) AS n FROM (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec" AS gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") t

panels.title: Avg Height Gain by Location
panels.sql: SELECT b."Location", ROUND(AVG(b."Height cm" - e."Height cm"), 1) AS avg_gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Gain by Coach
panels.sql: SELECT b."Coach", ROUND(AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Locations by Overall Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT b."Location", ROUND(AVG(b."Height cm" - e."Height cm"), 1) AS height_gain, ROUND(AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups"), 1) AS situps_gain, ROUND(AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec"), 1) AS shuttle_gain FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY height_gain DESC LIMIT 10
